name: Framer
description: Framer is a design and website-building platform that combines a visual canvas with AI agents that generate designs, write custom code, and manage a synced CMS for publishing live sites.
best_for: Designers, startup founders, and marketing teams who want to design and publish production websites without writing code, including AI-assisted workflows.
features: Canvas-native AI design agent that generates and refines layouts
Agent-powered custom code generation for interactions and effects
CMS agent that sets up, organizes, and updates content collections
Built-in A/B testing and analytics dashboard
SEO tools and Core Web Vitals performance monitoring
Integration with external AI tools like Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Cursor

alternatives.name: Figma

alternatives.name: Webflow
